subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 12 updates

question: Should the grouped privileged-action update be approved after the four guard assertions are synchronized and the rebased final head passes focused workflow checks?
rationale: The code defects have a mechanical repair, but accepting one grouped change across token creation, scanning, publishing, registry login/build, and agent execution crosses protected workflow ownership.

options.title: Approve after repair
options.body: Review and approve the verified upstream deltas after guard synchronization and exact-head validation.

options.title: Recreate smaller batches
options.body: Split or recreate the dependency group if twelve privileged action upgrades are too broad for one security review.

recommendation.title: Approve after repair
recommendation.body: Review and approve the verified upstream deltas after guard synchronization and exact-head validation.

likelyOwner.reason: The current guard/workflow snapshot is directly attributed to this owner, with the security operations team required for protected paths.
